2609.39982.title: Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents
2609.39982.paper_summary: Terminal agents act through stochastic model generations, yet the ability to generate a useful action does not ensure its reliable execution. A poor command (e.g., wrong package install) can change the environment in ways that hinder subsequent progress, even when the model could generate a better alternative. We investigate whether allocating test-time compute at the model-harness boundary can improve action reliability and trajectory success, and what makes this allocation effective. To study these questions, we introduce Mid-Harness, which samples and verifies candidate actions before forwarding one for execution, while keeping the generator and harness unchanged. With a TMAX-9B generator, more action sampling yields little benefit under weak verification, whereas a capable verifier can exploit useful alternatives from the same generator. On TerminalBench-Lite, a GPT-5.6 Sol verifier raises Pass@1 from 50.00% for the base agent to 68.03% with 8 sampled actions. When the same TMAX-9B model serves as the verifier, pairwise verification performs best among the evaluated verification mechanisms. Distilling responses from the stronger verifier into TMAX-9B further improves Pass@1, while leaving the action generator unchanged. With TMAX-9B on TerminalBench-Lite, combining action and trajectory scaling reaches higher success at lower estimated token cost than generating more trajectories alone. Mid-Harness also improves performance across additional models, benchmarks, and harnesses. These findings identify action scaling as a promising target for test-time compute scaling in terminal agents.
2609.39982.paper_summary_zh: 終端代理透過隨機模型生成進行操作，但生成有用行動的能力並不保證其可靠執行。糟糕的指令（例如，錯誤的套件安裝）可能會以阻礙後續進展的方式改變環境，即使模型能生成更好的替代方案。我們研究在模型與工具邊界分配測試時間計算是否能改善行動可靠性和軌跡成功率，以及使這種分配有效的因素。為了研究這些問題，我們引入了Mid-Harness，它在轉發執行的候選行動之前進行採樣和驗證，同時保持生成器和工具不變。使用TMAX-9B生成器，在弱驗證下更多的行動採樣幾乎沒有好處，而一個有能力的驗證器可以從同一生成器中利用有用的替代方案。在TerminalBench-Lite上，GPT-5.6 Sol驗證器將基礎代理的Pass@1從50.00%提高到68.03%，使用了8個採樣行動。當同一TMAX-9B模型作為驗證器時，成對驗證在評估的驗證機制中表現最佳。將來自更強驗證器的回應提煉到TMAX-9B進一步提高了Pass@1，同時保持行動生成器不變。在TerminalBench-Lite上，結合行動和軌跡縮放在估計的標記成本較低的情況下達到更高的成功率，這比單獨生成更多軌跡更有效。Mid-Harness還改善了其他模型、基準和工具的性能。這些發現確定行動縮放是終端代理中測試時間計算縮放的一個有前景的目標。
